evidence_backed_direction.measured_failure: V11 passed independent A/B identity, palette-Scale18 and selector codec closure, and all 312 Dynamic Scale32 events, but every one of 169 tensors regressed against the sealed V10 ledger, aggregate BF16 SSE rose from 2153.4047236346078 to 2351.9847979241645, and exact non-evaluator sequence agreement fell to 1/8.
evidence_backed_direction.binding_constraint: Do not trade exact packed-Scale24 row values for exponent-palette compression. Preserve V10 row-scale precision and use only its measured byte reserve for representational capacity.
evidence_backed_direction.replacement_hypothesis: Use four codebook banks only for the standard-layer q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, and up_proj families, keep down_proj in the V10 dual-bank format, and partition lm_head into 64 fixed contiguous row groups with independent dual-bank codebooks but no new selector bits.
evidence_backed_direction.distinctness: V12 has a mixed bank-count stream and an implicit lm_head row-group codebook schedule. It does not mutate, resume, or officially execute V10 or V11; all construction occurs under a fresh V12 namespace.

model.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight share the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model.split_operation: clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before construction and set only in-memory tie_word_embeddings false
model.embedding_preservation: the original embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged
model.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linears plus separated lm_head

weight_policy.payload_packing: row-major output row then input lane; even flat index in low nibble and odd flat index in high nibble

packed_scale24.fields: little-endian 16-bit normalized unsigned-Q1.15 significand followed by signed int8 exponent
packed_scale24.decode: restore the reserved high byte to zero before Scale32 validation or arithmetic

lm_head_bank_policy.row_group_rule: group_id equals floor(output_row_ordinal / 2374); every group is exact because 64 times 2374 equals 151936
lm_head_bank_policy.codebook_change_rule: load the next authenticated dual-bank set before the first row of each fixed group; no row-dependent or prompt-dependent group choice exists

v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.source: pinned BF16 weights, reviewed V10 construction code and immutable V10 evidence hashes; no official prompt, output, token, response-gate, hidden-harness, or golden data
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.v10_compatible_seed: Build the V10-format seed under the V12 namespace and require all 169 decoded BF16 reconstruction hashes, packed Scale24 records, payloads, dual codebooks, selectors, and aggregate SSE to match the sealed V10 evidence before V12 expansion. No file in the V10 namespace may be written.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.strict_superset_initialization: For selected standard module families, copy V10 bank 0 into banks 0 and 2 and V10 bank 1 into banks 1 and 3, then map each V10 selector bit to the identical lower bank id. For lm_head, copy each V10 dual-bank set into all 64 row groups and retain every V10 selector bit. This must reproduce V10 byte-for-byte after decode before optimization.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.standard_selector_and_payload_step: For every selected standard module row/block, evaluate all four banks under the exact decoded Scale24 row value, choose minimum exact source-space BF16 SSE, then lower bank id; assign each weight to the nearest codepoint with lower-index ties.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.standard_codebook_step: For each selected standard module input block and bank, solve the exact globally minimum strictly increasing 16-entry signed-Q4.4 codebook with the reviewed dynamic program; empty banks retain their prior values and ties choose the lexicographically lower bank.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.lm_head_group_step: For each of the 64 fixed row groups and seven input blocks, update its two codebook banks and the existing one-bit per-row selectors using exact source-space BF16 SSE. Group boundaries, selector width, Scale24 rows, and payload width remain fixed.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.down_proj_rule: Preserve the complete V10 decoded down_proj representation and metadata unchanged; any mismatch is illegal.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.scale_rule: Preserve all V10 packed Scale24 row records exactly; V12 does not optimize, palette-compress, or otherwise change row scales.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.iteration_acceptance: No tensor may regress against its V10-compatible seed after any complete iteration; execute all eight iterations even after a fixed point.
v10_compatible_seed_and_construction.determinism: Independent candidate A/B seed, expanded metadata, payload, codebook, selector, reconstruction, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests must match byte-for-byte.

clock_reset_and_protocol.reset: active-low asynchronous assertion with synchronized release; reset invalidates partially loaded codebooks, selectors, Scale24 rows, and lm_head group state
clock_reset_and_protocol.backpressure: every metadata and payload beat remains stable while valid and not ready; no stall may alter row-group, block, bank, selector, or payload ordering
clock_reset_and_protocol.four_bank_metadata_order: bank 0, bank 1, bank 2, bank 3 for one input block before the next block
clock_reset_and_protocol.dual_bank_metadata_order: bank 0 then bank 1 for one input block before the next block
clock_reset_and_protocol.lm_head_group_transition: a group transition is legal only after all rows and responses for the preceding 2374-row group retire; the next group's codebooks authenticate before its first projection issue
clock_reset_and_protocol.recovery: after reset or interrupted preparation, restart from an authenticated completed tensor or lm_head row-group boundary; provisional destinations are unusable

activation_policy.payload: signed A8 symmetric range -127 through +127 with -128 reserved
activation_policy.selection_rule: preserve the authenticated base activation Scale32 significand and choose the minimum legal integer exponent delta covering every live group without saturation

pre_attempt_closure.format_gate: Two independent V12 builds must match; V10-compatible seed reproduction, mixed two/four-bank codebooks, selector widths, fixed lm_head 64-group schedule, exact packed Scale24 rows, payloads, padding, identities, byte accounting, and manifests must close exactly.
pre_attempt_closure.model_gate: All 169 tensors must be non-regressing against the sealed V10 per-tensor SSE ledger, aggregate literal unweighted BF16 SSE must be strictly below 2153.4047236346078, and the V10-compatible seed must reproduce all 169 sealed V10 reconstruction hashes before V12 updates.
pre_attempt_closure.non_evaluator_quality_gate: The unchanged eight construction-blind non-evaluator inputs must achieve 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching BF16 response-gate outcomes before an official marker may be created.
pre_attempt_closure.dynamic_gate: A fresh V12 candidate must cover all 312 named activation boundaries with legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, no reserved -128 payload, and no more than 832 activation-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token.
pre_attempt_closure.failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

risk_register: The standard-layer reserve is only 308.48 bytes. Every selector pad bit and codebook byte is binding and must fail closed on mismatch.
The lm_head grouping is fixed before execution and may improve source SSE without closing exact token identity; the 8/8 construction-blind gate remains decisive.
Fresh V10-compatible seed construction must not write, resume, or execute under the terminal V10 namespace.
Four-bank decode is limited to six standard module families; an illegal mode for down_proj or lm_head must fail before projection issue.

An accepted numerical policy would still require a Manager stage advance, focused RTL regression, one fresh tree-specific PPA after any core RTL change, local arbitrary-text demo acceptance, and later U280 work.
